step3.lineDelivery: Delivery, setup & teardown at the end of the event
step3.policyForce: War or pandemic — the amount paid will be transferred as credit toward an alternative date subject to availability; if no agreed date is found, 50% of the total transaction will not be refunded to the client.
step3.policyOther: In any other cancellation, no payment will be refunded and the client will be charged the full transaction amount.
step3.policyNoAlt: If no alternative date is found, the client may come collect the equipment ordered for the event at full payment, without delivery and setup, leaving a deposit for the equipment's return.
step3.changes1: Minor add-on quantities can be updated up to 30 business days before the event date.
step3.equipment: during the event is on the client (except for natural wear and tear).
step3.balance: By bank transfer about a week before the event date.

terms.required: You must accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy to continue.

privacyBody: At LD Event Design we respect your privacy. The details you provide in the form (name, phone, email, event details and digital signature) are used solely to process the order, contact you and provide the service.
We do not share your details with third parties that are not required to provide the service, and we store them securely.
You may contact us at any time to review, correct or delete your information at 054-5740423.
termsBody: The order is subject to the engagement terms and the cancellation policy detailed in the agreement document.
Confirming the order and the digital signature constitute acceptance of the terms. Prices are in ILS and include the components detailed in the order.
Changes, add-ons and cancellations are handled according to the policy detailed in the agreement.
accessibilityBody: This site was built with a commitment to accessibility for all users, following the WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.
The site supports full keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes, a proper heading structure, RTL/LTR direction and text resizing.
Encountered an accessibility issue? We'll be glad to help and fix it — call 054-5740423.
